_about: 787-8, from Boeing D6-58333 Rev Q 2.2.1 (page index 20): side, plan and front views on one sheet, a picture (about 45 px a meter at scale 8). Line centres. The 787-9's points moved by the two shorter plugs onto this sheet and snapped; the wing's plan points placed here. Scaled by the printed 56.72 m overall length from the nose to the tail cone's tip; the drawn doors 1, 2 and 4 then land within 0.1 m of the door-location table (2.7.1). Door 3, hidden behind the wing, is placed from the table; the windows behind the wing's lines at the drawing's pitch. The cockpit panes are the 787-9's (the same nose), which land on this sheet's drawn panes.

sources.title: Boeing, 787 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (D6-58333 Rev Q, October 2025), 2.2.1 General Dimensions: Model 787-8; 2.7.1 Door Locations
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/b788/), starting from the 787-9's points moved by the two shorter fuselage plugs; the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. Door 3 is placed from the door-location table; the cockpit panes are the 787-9's (the same nose). The sheet prints the engine 9.73 m out; its drawing has it at 9.94 m, as the 787-9's sheet prints (9.91 m) for the same wing, so the shape keeps the drawing's.
